lines: Hello there, mortal. And welcome to hell
There is no way out, you're stuck here eternally
Your only passtime is entertaining me
How you ask? By dying uniquely
Die in enough different ways, and I have gifts awaiting
I'm bored now, so back to life with you. Don't disappoint me
How boring... I've already seen you die this way before
Be more creative, and you'll be rewarded in return
By the way.. I've left you a gift for your hard work thus far
Keep entertaining me, and I'll keep providing you with tools
Now show me what you can do
Hah, slow and painful those pricks must've been
Ok I'm bored, back to life with you
Bah, lava is boring, it kills far too quick
I prefer when real suffering can take place
Death by a hundred stings
It's funny how swollen your body got
Heh, splat
Ok, kind of funny how you just keeled over and died
Did the mushroom at least taste good?
